title.narrative: ActionAid - Empowering Civil Society Organisations to mobilise Citizen Actions towards green economy and environment sustainability in Central River Region (North, and South) and North Bank Region (NBR).

description.narrative: The overall objective is to build the capacity of CSOs to increase their participation in national development. The specific objective is to promote community advocacy and consolidate climate adaptive capacities of women and youth on green economic policies and environmental sustainability.
